name: openrouter-prices
source: OpenRouter's public model list, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models (no key), each model's pricing.prompt, pricing.completion and pricing.input_cache_read, in dollars per token, multiplied here by one million
notes: List prices on the day fetched, not a quote; OpenRouter can change them at any time, and the provider it routes a call to may bill differently (RV-DES-11).
openai/gpt-5.6-terra lists a higher price for prompts of 272,000 tokens or more (4 and 18 dollars per million); no registered call is estimated that large, so the base price is used.
deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 lists 0.22 in and 9.5 out, where pi-ai 1.3.0's catalogue (2026-10-15) lists 0.66 in and 1.98 out: the output price is almost five times the catalogue's.
openai/gpt-4.1 stands for tau2-bench's retail judge and user simulator, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 upstream; OpenRouter lists no dated id for it.
